scope: BLAKE3 update only native, standard production proof/search budgets and cache disabled. No runtime benchmark or runtime speedup claim.

diagnosis.misleading_final_reason_before: the coupling search exceeded its budget

fix.equality: Memoize structural term pairs and allow same-name parameter views retaining the same declared bits. Keep all enclosing operation widths; require equal operand widths for comparisons and float operations, and strict equality under quantifiers. Do not rewrite terms or alter global structural identity.
fix.termination: Stop coupling search when its shared diagram, implication, valuation-work or candidate budget is exhausted, preserving the specific cause. Previously a depleted diagram budget could be hidden by later candidate-budget exhaustion.

negative_cases: One changed output bit is refuted.
Truncation of a declared u32 to eight bits remains distinct.
Signed comparisons at eight and 32 bits remain distinct.
Float operand widths retain their interpretation.
A quantifier's bound name cannot use an external declaration it shadows.
Unknown or invalid declaration widths cannot justify a width relaxation.

selection_after_integration.difference: The concurrent late-cleanup change removes one branch; the equality fix alone preserves the original object.

emission_wall_seconds.caveat: Single runs under concurrent host load; the baseline includes compact diagnostic instrumentation. These are not controlled compile-time comparisons or hash runtime measurements.
